description.zh-CN: 插件进程可写的绝对路径。推荐使用独立目录，不要与 core local 驱动混用。
description.en-US: Absolute path writable by the plugin process. Prefer a dedicated directory; do not share the core local driver root.

description.zh-CN: 若填写，PublicURL 会拼成 base + object key。留空则依赖宿主内容代理。
description.en-US: When set, PublicURL becomes base + object key. Leave blank to rely on host content proxy.
